instruction: tomli.loads(s, parse_float=...) and tomli.load accept a parse_float callable that turns TOML float strings into values. If it returns a dict or a list (or a subclass of either), those values get mixed up with parsed tables and arrays. Raise ValueError('parse_float must not return dicts or lists') instead as soon as parse_float returns such a value, for floats anywhere in the document (top level, tables, arrays, inline tables). Any other return value, such as a Decimal or a str, is used as before, and the default float keeps its speed. Update the README's note on illegal types.
